name: Common Cold
advice: Rest, drink warm fluids, try steam inhalation and saltwater gargles. Usually clears in 7-10 days.

name: Influenza (Flu)
advice: Rest, stay hydrated and monitor your fever. See a doctor if symptoms last more than 3-4 days.

name: Viral Fever
advice: Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Consult a doctor if fever persists beyond 3 days.

name: Dengue-like Illness
advice: Drink plenty of fluids and avoid self-medicating with aspirin or ibuprofen. Get a blood test if fever lasts over 2 days.

name: Allergic Rhinitis
advice: Avoid triggers like dust and pollen. An antihistamine may help; ask a pharmacist.

name: Sinusitis
advice: Use steam inhalation and saline rinses. See a doctor if symptoms last more than 10 days.

name: Gastroenteritis
advice: Sip oral rehydration solution often. See a doctor if you cannot keep fluids down or it lasts over 2 days.

name: Migraine
advice: Rest in a dark, quiet room and stay hydrated. See a doctor if migraines are frequent or severe.

name: Throat Infection
advice: Gargle warm salt water and drink warm fluids. A doctor can check if it needs antibiotics.

name: Bronchitis
advice: Rest, drink fluids and avoid smoke. See a doctor if the cough lasts more than a week.

name: COVID-like Illness
advice: Consider getting tested and avoid close contact with others until you know.

name: Skin Allergy
advice: Avoid scratching and suspected triggers. Seek care if the rash spreads or swells.
